Subtract 350 days from 1096-08-12.  
1096 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not a century exception in Gregorian rules for that era).  
From 1096-08-12 back 350 days:  
First go back 12 days → 1096-07-31.  
Back 31 more days → 1096-06-30.  
Remaining days: 350 - 12 - 31 = 307 days.  
Go back month-by-month through 1096 and into 1095:  
From 1096-06-30 back 30 days → 1096-05-31 (30 days).  
Back 31 → 1096-04-30 (61 total).  
Back 30 → 1096-03-31 (91).  
Back 31 → 1096-02-29 (122) (leap year).  
Back 31 → 1096-01-31 (153).  
Now into 1095:  
From 1096-01-01 back 1 day → 1095-12-31 (154).  
Remaining: 307 - 154 = 153 days left to subtract in 1095.  
1095 is not leap (1095/4 not integer).  
Month-by-month backward from 1095-12-31:  
Dec 31 → Nov 30: 31 days (total subtracted in this phase: 31, remaining: 122).  
Nov 30 → Oct 31: 30 days (total 61, remaining 92).  
Oct 31 → Sep 30: 31 days (total 92, remaining 61).  
Sep 30 → Aug 31: 30 days (total 122, remaining 31).  
Aug 31 → Jul 31: 31 days (total 153, remaining 0).  
So final date is 1095-07-31.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1095-07-31
